dogecoin.text: If this keeps going then those who say, 'I lost a lot of money on Bitcoin' are one thing, but those who say, 'I lost a lot of money on DogeCoin' will really have to look in the mirror...

DogeCoin on the other hand disgusts me, is the pin-up for all shitcoins and I hope it fails.
